name: am-audio-record
label: AM audio record (headless)
description: All-native AM receiver that writes demodulated mono audio to /tmp/ferrite-am-audio.wav. Source → Channelizer (10×, tight filter) → Decimator (5×) → AmDemod @ 48 kHz with post-demod gain → FileAudioSink. AM has a 10 kHz channel so the discriminator stays at audio rate — no aliasing concern. The envelope detector leaves a small AC residual after the DC blocker, so audio_gain ≈ 20 brings a strong station to a playable level. Tune center_freq_hz to the station of interest (AM broadcast is 530–1700 kHz; shortwave lives higher) before invoking `ferrited --flowgraph am-audio-record.json --source-type SoapySource --source-args driver=sdrplay --run-for-secs 30 --start`.
ai_notes: Headless all-native AM receiver that writes demodulated mono audio to a WAV file. Useful for unattended recording of an AM station over a defined window; the demod runs on the server with no UI involvement. Not a listen preset — there's no AudioSink, so the browser won't play audio while this is loaded.
